metadata.title: The Origin of the 300 km s$^{-1}$ Stream Near Segue 1

notes: No star qualifies. The paper identifies members of the 300S stellar stream (T:p16-b6), but its best-fit orbit is a periodic Milky Way orbit with an apogalacticon of 60 kpc, a perigalacticon of 4.1 kpc, and an orbital period of ~1 Gyr (T:p17-b1). The paper does not identify any individual star as presently unbound from the Galaxy.
